items.raw_excerpt: The U.S. dollar fell sharply against the Taiwan dollar Monday, shedding NT$0.194 to close at NT$31.852.
items.summary_en: The U.S. dollar fell sharply against the Taiwan dollar on Monday. The greenback shed NT$0.194 to close at NT$31.852 on the Taipei forex market.
items.summary_ko: 미국 달러화가 월요일 타이베이 외환시장에서 대만 달러 대비 크게 하락했습니다. 환율은 0.194대만달러 하락한 31.852대만달러로 마감했습니다.
items.title_en: U.S. Dollar Drops Sharply on Taipei Forex Market
items.title_ko: 타이베이 외환시장에서 미국 달러 환율 크게 하락
items.title_original: U.S. dollar closes sharply lower on Taipei forex market

items.raw_excerpt: A government-funded program that annually sends Taiwanese with agricultural expertise overseas for exchanges with local counterparts is now open for applications, with selected "ambassadors" set to visit the Netherlands for the first time, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) announced Monday.
items.summary_en: A Taiwanese government program is sending agricultural experts to the Netherlands. This is the first time the exchange will visit the Dutch. Applications are now open for the selected ambassadors.
items.summary_ko: 대만 정부가 농업 전문가를 네덜란드로 보내는 프로그램을 운영합니다. 이번이 처음으로 네덜란드를 방문하는 교류 프로그램입니다. 선정된 '대사'들의 지원이 시작되었습니다.
items.title_en: Taiwan's agricultural ambassadors to visit Netherlands
items.title_original: Taiwan's annual agricultural ambassadors to visit Netherlands
